name: plate_dimensions_itself
why: ENTRY Z-H3. The plate of `Checks/DimXpert` (24/9/2026): 100 x 60 x 10 with a through hole of 20 in the centre. A DimXpert scheme, from the core and without an add-in, with three references — bottom, left side, back — must put the dimensions a draughtsman would put, with the right values.
_why_the_values_and_not_the_count: Any six dimensions would be six dimensions. `values_mm` is the ordered list of the numbers the dimensions carry, and it is what tells a right scheme from one that dimensioned something else: 10 the thickness, 20 the hole, 30 and 50 the position of the hole from the two reference sides, 60 and 100 the sides.

expect.tolerance_why: the values are written by DimXpert in the name of the dimension, rounded to the thousandth
